_comment: IL_Replay card keys that data/cards/replay_cards.json (royaleimitate 0.2.15, vendored unchanged) lacks. tools/rs_cards.py load() adds them to it.
key: the IL_Replay (RoyaleAPI) card key without its -ev1 / -hero form suffix. name: the RoyaleSim catalogue name, which is row[0] of catalogue_json().

verified: false until `tools/rs_cards.py --coverage` finds the key in the IL_Replay corpus decks. Set it to true then. The keys come from the RoyaleAPI deck strings in data/ladder/. The names come from the engine: the catalogue has DarkMagic, GiantBuffer and MergeMaiden (tools/rs_cards.py --catalogue, and the engine-marked test in tests/pipeline/test_rs_cards.py).
An extra may not give a key that the vendored file already maps to a different name. HASTYCR_CARD_EXTRAS=0 leaves all of them out.

rune-giant.name: GiantBuffer
rune-giant.evidence: Rune Giant. Key: the decks in data/ladder/opponent_meta.json and battles_2p6.csv. Name: the client's codename for it (scripts/sync_meta_decks.py PUBLISHED_ALIASES, giant_buffer). Verified 2026-10-29 by tools/rs_cards.py --coverage --parts 4 on the owner's PC: rune-giant in 923 decks, spirit-empress in 616, void in 2,272; all 16 cards mapped in 20,000 of 20,000 matches.

spirit-empress.name: MergeMaiden
spirit-empress.evidence: Spirit Empress. Key: the decks in data/ladder/opponent_meta.json and battles_2p6.csv. Name: royalesim's calibration ledger calls it 'the Spirit Empress (MergeMaiden)'. It is a variant card, and its forms are MergeMaiden_Normal (3 elixir) and MergeMaiden_Mounted (6). The card in a deck is MergeMaiden. Verified 2026-10-29 by tools/rs_cards.py --coverage --parts 4 on the owner's PC: rune-giant in 923 decks, spirit-empress in 616, void in 2,272; all 16 cards mapped in 20,000 of 20,000 matches.

void.name: DarkMagic
void.evidence: Void. Key: the decks in data/ladder/opponent_meta.json and battles_2p6.csv, and tests/test_replay_pipeline.py uses 'void' as an IL_Replay key. Name: the client calls it dark_magic (sim/spells.py). Verified 2026-10-29 by tools/rs_cards.py --coverage --parts 4 on the owner's PC: rune-giant in 923 decks, spirit-empress in 616, void in 2,272; all 16 cards mapped in 20,000 of 20,000 matches.
